gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: stable support edges should improve the multi-peer cluster source by keeping laggards whose peer relation is persistent inside the prior window while filtering transient crosstalk.

2_history_check.exp-20260606-025: Accepted rolling-correlation peer shock is the comparator.
2_history_check.exp-20260609-014: Multi-peer cluster improved late/mid but failed old_thin drawdown and was rejected.
2_history_check.exp-20260613-028: Same-sector purity made the multi-peer source worse. This run does not use static sector labels; it tests temporal edge stability inside the PIT correlation window.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-006: Correlation-breakdown idiosyncratic leader failed drawdown and window gates. This keeps positive peer-shock transfer and only tests edge stability.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-007: Earnings peer underreaction was too thin and failed the accepted relation comparator.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Accept only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no EV/PnL regression window, target sample >=20 across all three windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration guard passes, and accepted rolling-corr peer-shock comparator is beaten.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: if exp-20260609-014 failed because some multi-peer edges were unstable crosstalk, requiring each candidate to have at least two supporting peer edges that stay positively correlated in both halves of the PIT 60-session lookback should preserve true peer-information transfer while removing noisy laggards.
interpretation: Multi-peer edge stability did not clear Gate 4 or did not beat the accepted rolling-correlation peer-shock comparator; do not promote or keep tuning this high-order correlation family on frozen windows.
negative_reflection: If rejected, prior-window edge stability did not fix the multi-peer cluster failure; the edge is probably still broad momentum/correlation exposure or the stability gate thinned useful winners. Do not answer by sweeping corr/lookback/support/top-N/hold/notional on frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially new PIT relation provenance, such as customer/supplier links, named counterparty evidence, or forward replacement-value rows versus accepted relation comparators.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping relation lookback, min corr, support count, half-window correlation, stability spread, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or notional thresholds on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Need named economic relation provenance or forward displacement rows before revisiting multi-peer correlation-cluster alpha.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.5597; aggregate PnL delta $+5,045.10.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The edge-stability gate tested whether exp-20260609-014's old_thin loss was mostly transient correlation crosstalk. If it failed, stable half-window correlations still did not isolate a durable relation edge after next-open execution and costs.
